title: Military Gen III Extreme Cold Weather Parka - Level 7 Large Long
descriptionHtml:
This is a Gen III Extreme Cold Weather Parka (ECWCS Level 7) that is used in the US Army. The parka is designed for use during static operations. Constructed with a water resistant outer shell and with PrimaLoft® Sport Thermal bonded high-loft insulation, it will keep you warm and dry. This jacket offers all of these features and yet it is lightweight and compressible. These jackets run a large to allow for layering underneath using the rest of the pieces from the Military ECWCS system.

 

**Used condition may have some black smudging.

 

Features:

 

ECWCS Level 7 – This level consists of a high loft insulated parka and trousers set that are for wear in extreme cold conditions while static. The parka and trousers are wind and water resistant and meant to be worn as the outer most layer in dry (non wet weather conditions, snow on the ground is ok) environments where movement is limited.

Oversized Clothing – This clothing item is oversized to fit over gear worn on the torso or other gear and clothing worn beneath. FOR Tops and Bottoms it is recommended that you order a size smaller than you are unless you intend to wear body armor or bulky gear underneath.

Water Resistant – It can be exposed to water for a short period of time without being damaged or saturated with water. Generally not recommended to submerge Water Resistant items unless item is made for that level of exposure.

Zip Up Shirt – This shirt is a zip up, which means that the front is closed with a zipper.

Adjustable Sleeve Cuffs – Sleeves have either a button or hook and loop adjustable cuff for fit and wear.

Stow Away Hood – There is a stow away hood in the jackets collar for inclement weather.

Part Of ECWCS – This is part of the US Army Extended Cold Weather Clothing System that is used to protect the wearer from cold to extreme cold weather situations and environments. The system consists of 7 levels of clothing and various accessories that can be worn in multiple configurations. When worn properly in appropriate conditions the system is designed to keep Soldiers warm in temperatures from +40 degrees to -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

Manufactured by:

 

Various Government Contractors – This item is manufactured for the US government by various contractors.

Country of Manufacture: USA – This product is manufactured in the #1 country, the USA.

 

Issue Type: US Army Issue – This item is genuine US Army issue.
